about.title: About ShiftLK Spares
about.subtitle: Connecting Sri Lankan riders and motorbike enthusiasts with genuine Indian bike parts, custom modifications, body stickers, and protective gear.
about.storyText: Located on Palagama Road, Undurugoda, Polgasowita, ShiftLK Spares was founded to cater specifically to Sri Lankan motorbike riders. We specialize in genuine and OEM spare parts for popular Indian motorcycles (Bajaj, Yamaha, TVS, Honda), exciting custom modification parts, stylish body stickers & graphic wraps, and safety-certified helmets—all backed by friendly WhatsApp support and swift doorstep delivery to every district in Sri Lanka.
about.feature1: Specialized Motorbike Range: Dedicated inventory for Bajaj, Yamaha, and top Indian motorcycles alongside custom mods and stickers from Polgasowita.
about.feature2: Fitment & Compatibility Guarantee: Never worry about wrong parts. Our technicians verify your exact bike model and year before dispatch.
about.feature3: No Hidden Fees: Clear delivery pricing for all 25 districts of Sri Lanka directly calculated on our website.

delivery.title: Islandwide Delivery Information
delivery.subtitle: Flat courier rates across all 25 districts and economical sticker post
delivery.westernDesc: Flat Rs. 425 for the first 1.0 kg to any district, plus Rs. 100 for each additional 1 kg above 1 kg. Doorstep delivery across all 25 districts.
delivery.outstationDesc: Order any number of motorcycle sticker cards under 250g for just Rs. 220 flat islandwide via Sri Lanka Post Speed Post.
delivery.importantNote: Standard courier parcels up to 1.0 kg are charged at Rs. 425/- flat islandwide. Each additional kg is Rs. 100/-. Body stickers under 250g are delivered via SL Speed Post for only Rs. 220/-.

returns.title: Returns & Warranty Policy
returns.subtitle: Fair, transparent policies designed to give you complete peace of mind
returns.p1Desc: If an item received does not match the specifications or vehicle compatibility agreed upon, contact us within 7 days of delivery for an immediate replacement or full refund.
returns.p2Desc: Mechanical components carry our standard replacement guarantee. For delicate electrical sensors, alternators, and computers, please install with a certified automobile electrician.
returns.p3Desc: Items must be returned in their original packaging, uninstalled, without grease or mounting marks.
